name: Deyer
description: Deyer was one of three habitable, but inhospitable, planets in the Anoat system of the Anoat sector, located in the Greater Javin of the Outer Rim. It was a colony world consisting primarily of oceans and was composed of floating raft cities, including the city of Feiya, and terraformed lakes. It featured abundant aquatic life.
